'''Sol Proofrock''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] gangster who hired [[Bal Rado]] to bring him [[Spice/Legends|spice]]. But Rado lost his spices. Later Sol hired Rado's partner [[Droo Wabbin]] to [[Death/Legends|kill]] him.<ref name="Coruscant Nights III: Patterns of Force" />
